messages:
Emilia (CEO): Posting the reliability Q&A follow-up from today's all-hands here. RCA link: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Use this thread for clarifying q's and action confirmations.

Sam (VP Eng): Short summary: ~35m latency spike due to autoscaler misconfig + cache TTL regression after a weekend deploy. Mitigation: manual scale + rollback. Action items listed below.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Action items I own: finish RCA timeline + attach missing cache logs (due 2026-03-27), add alert infra:cache-ttl-drift, and schedule a blameless review.

Jess (Customer Ops): I'll draft customer comms (plain language) and compile impacted account list. Draft ETA: EOD tomorrow. Posting link when ready.

Tara (Product): Product will map impacted customers to severity buckets and own "deploy safety checklist" roadmap item.

Diego (Oncall): Oncall will run 48h canary with extra tail-latency traces. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary. Canary starts 02:00 UTC.

Lina (Docs): I'll produce a short "one-pager" for onboarding and add a "what went wrong / how to avoid" section. ETA end of sprint.

Sam (VP Eng): Ops note: no config pushes to dedicated pools without review. We'll add a gating checklist to deploy bot.

eng-bot (incidents): Incident INC-2026-248 created and linked to RCA.

Rohit (SRE Lead): quick grep to find TTL regression: kubectl logs -l app=ingress-cache -n prod | grep -n "ttl_override" -C2

Jess (Customer Ops): Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-draft — please review and @mention legal if needed.

Emilia (CEO): Please react here when you complete your action items so we can triage closures. Thanks for the fast cross-team work. :clap:
